request: Should we rewrite our billing service in Rust this quarter?
facts: The billing service is 40,000 lines of Python and has run in production for three years.
Its p99 latency is 80 ms against a 500 ms target; there is no open performance complaint.
None of the three engineers on the team has shipped Rust to production.
The quarter's roadmap already holds two deliverables promised to customers.
No customer or internal team has asked for the rewrite.
note: Sanity case: a large cost with no stated need should not pass.
